title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
abstract: arXiv:2608.24857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. translated_title: 提示结构重新分配而非减少：对LLM生成的Python代码中安全弱点的实证分析
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地从自然语言提示生成代码，使得提示工程成为塑造生成软件安全性的关键机制。结构化和安全导向的提示被广泛用于鼓励更安全的代码，但其效果不仅仅局限于检测到的弱点是否存在。我们使用424个安全敏感的Python任务，在五种逐步添加结构和安全指导的提示变体下，用GPT-4o和LLaMA 3.1-8B生成解决方案，并使用Bandit和CodeQL沿两个轴评估：生成合规性和安全弱点普遍性、严重性及CWE分布。结构化提示显著减少了拒绝（例如，GPT-4o的无效输出从424个中的338个降至37-52个），从而支持大规模分析，但安全导向的细化并未一致地减少整体弱点普遍性。对于GPT-4o，更强的提示主要重新分配了弱点类型和严重性，而非消除它们。
tldr: 结构化提示能提高LLM代码生成的合规性，但安全导向的提示并未减少弱点总数，而是重新分配了弱点的类型和严重性。
en_tdlr: Structured prompts improve LLM code generation compliance, but security-oriented prompts do not reduce overall weakness prevalence; instead, they redistribute weakness types and severities.
